Okay, so about a year and a half ago I was at home taking a bath. I turned off the running water just to soak for a bit, that's when I heard some weird mumbling. I figured it was the tv and continued to relax. After I decided it was time to face my responsibilities and get out the tub, I started to let the water drain. I sat in the empty tub for a minute or two just idling for time when I clearly heard it. It was a young girl's voice coming straight from the other side of the door. Now let me preface this with saying it's just my mom and I living together and she had left to go to work. There was no way in hell anyone should have been on the other side of that door.

So I called my mom crying and she pushed it off as me leaving the tv on in my room which was connected to the bathroom. But I specifically remembered turning it off. While I'm on the phone, the little girl's voice never stopped. Basically I sat in an empty tub crying and texting all my friends that I was going to be killed by a little ghost girl.

After about 30 minutes it stops, I get out and nothing else is weird for a week or two. Then the dreams.

Now usually I have weird dreams but they're for the most part unsensical and unrealistic. However, I began to dream about a little girl dressed in 1800's garb. Weird, but whatever it's a dream. She begins to tell me her name, Evelyn, and wants to be friends. These go on for about three days. For some reason they put me at ease. Like sure I may have a ghost, but she's nice and everything's okay!

So whenever something weird would occur, I'd just be like "Oh that's my ghost Evelyn! She's nice, don't worry about it." So for about a year just small strange things would happen: tvs and lights turning on and off by themselves, things very clearly moving from their spots, just small things that could be chalked up to something that's not a ghost. But secretly I liked to believe it was her.

Now my mom was never really on board with all of this and probably thought I was going crazy (I have a past of anxiety and depression which my mom probably assumed I'm turning paranoid schizophrenic too and hallucinating a ghost.
